The Arrangement sidecar has comments or formatting that Capture does not keep. Saving rewrites the whole file. Continue?

file /proj/Bars.arrangements.lua (w) <<
-- REAPER Arrangements. Each entry is an ordered list of Region Names.
-- `headroom` adjusts a region's end, in seconds; 0 leaves it alone, and the
-- new end is always rounded to the nearest bar line. Shrinking may only ever
-- remove silence -- a run refuses rather than cutting into a region's content.
-- Edit freely; this file is read in a sandbox and validated on load.
-- Capture and the Arrange page rewrite this whole file when they save, so
-- comments and hand formatting are not kept.
return {
  ["Ghost"] = {
    { "Alpha", headroom = 0 },
    { "Zulu", headroom = 0 },
  },
  ["Headroom"] = {
    { "Alpha", headroom = 0 },
    { "Bravo", headroom = 4 },
    { "Delta", headroom = 0 },
  },
  ["Identity"] = {
    { "Alpha", headroom = 0 },
    { "Bravo", headroom = 0 },
    { "Charlie", headroom = 0 },
    { "Delta", headroom = 0 },
  },
  ["Live"] = {
    { "Alpha", headroom = 0 },
    { "Bravo", headroom = 0 },
    { "Charlie", headroom = 0 },
    { "Delta", headroom = 0 },
  },
  ["Reordered"] = {
    { "Charlie", headroom = 0 },
    { "Alpha", headroom = 0 },
    { "Delta", headroom = 0 },
    { "Bravo", headroom = 0 },
  },
  ["Shrink"] = {
    { "Alpha", headroom = 0 },
    { "Bravo", headroom = -20 },
    { "Delta", headroom = 0 },
  },
  ["Subset"] = {
    { "Alpha", headroom = 0 },
    { "Bravo", headroom = 0 },
    { "Delta", headroom = 0 },
  },
}
>>

ShowMessageBox("Capture Region Order", 0) -> 1 <<
Captured "Live" with 4 regions.

/proj/Bars.arrangements.lua

Next, in a text editor:

  1. Duplicate the ["Live"] = { ... } block and give the copy a different name.
  2. Reorder the Region Names inside the copy, or delete some to make a subset.
  3. Set `headroom` on any entry to add or remove seconds at that region's end. It is rounded to the nearest bar, and it is relative -- applying twice moves twice.
  4. Run 'Check Arrangement' on the new name, then 'Apply Arrangement', then 'Verify Arrangement'.

Editing the copy leaves "Live" intact as a record of the current order.
>>
